understanding: The supplied source resolves ballot-helper indexing and recovery bookkeeping retention. makeBallot treats its argument as an instance index, changes only that instance's lastTriedBallot, and does not reset counters. Recovery and prepare-reply retry pass the affected instance index; accept-reply retry passes the reported ballot while broadcasting Prepare for the reply's instance. Recovery dispatch has no leadership or committed-state guard. These observations refine the same F3 consumption question without establishing a legal counterexample. B9 is already present in the supplied merge base, so it is refined rather than reconstructed as a missing object.

It writes only the indexed instance's lastTriedBallot. Recovery and prepare-reply retry index by instance, whereas accept-reply retry indexes by the reported ballot.
